steps.title: Choose your route
steps.text: Purchase instantly through the domain’s listing on Atom.com, or send Midjump an inquiry to arrange a direct sale.

steps.title: Pay with protection
steps.text: Funds are held by Atom.com or Escrow.com until the transfer is complete. Payment plans are available through Atom.com.

steps.title: Take ownership
steps.text: Once the transfer completes, the domain moves to your registrar account, ready to build on.

faq.q: How does the purchase process work?
a: Purchases can be completed through Atom.com's escrow service, which handles payment and domain transfer.
Alternatively, you can contact Midjump to arrange a direct transaction through Escrow.com, including multi-domain acquisitions or custom arrangements.
Yes, each domain includes custom logo concepts, available to the buyer upon request.
